snippet.title: Firebat - Revolution TRAILER / TEASER
snippet.description:
The trailer / teaser to our brick-breaker style game by Tuan Publishing / Inked Pixel Software.
Publishing manager: Tibor Bayer
Project Manager: József (Hevő) Hevesi
Design, Code, GFX, SFX: László (Coyote) Eszik (Pixel Krajcár)
Music Composer: Zoltán (Bruce) Végh
Additional Coding: Tibor Kisfalusi (TibiSoft)
Switch conversion: József Punk

The game is about the Firebats, as they revolt against their oppressors and how one heroine starts to explore the Underworld. After finding the Sphera Artificium she tries to defeat Morningstar and his Lieutenants and find a way out, while finding clues about the Firebat's forgotten past.

The game have a bunch of interesting blocks and mechanics that the player has to learn and overcome. To help, the Sphera (the ball the player has to bounce around) levels up on every stage, and makes it easier to break the remaining blocks.
Find and defeat the hidden levels to earn Fire Pearls and use those to upgrade the different aspects of the Sphera, making the block breaking process even more easier.
Navigate on the Underworld Map, and with your upgraded Sphera earn new level score records on previously played levels.

You can buy the full version, or try the free demo on itch.io:
https://tuanpublishing.itch.io/firebat-revolution
